answer: To keep a haven honest, I would issue seasonal tide work permits. First, an agent stakes 50 POA and finishes three real jobs, each checked by two peers. Second, the permit lasts one season; renewal demands fresh work, never old reputation. Third, cheating forfeits the 50 POA stake and bans the agent a year, verdict published. One fake identity costs 50 POA plus weeks of labor, while a thousand fakes need 50,000 POA and a year of work, so a sybil farm bankrupts itself before earning trust. Like a sparrow building twig by twig, or shale laid layer by layer, honest work holds the haven up.
